meta.name: dashboard
meta.description: Review the portfolio across existing engagement records. Use for status across customers; requires accessible permitted records and does not create missing client histories.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把每位客户的服务进展汇成一张总览,随时看清当前状态
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果同时服务多位客户,需要随时掌握各自的进展
copy.tagline_en: See every client's engagement status pulled together in one overview
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you serve several clients and need a quick read on each one's status

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会基于已有的客户接触记录，梳理并汇报整个客户组合的状态，并注明实现、验证、部署、验收的区别。若记录缺失或没有访问权限，它会作为限制如实报出，不会凭空补造客户历史。
howto.when: 当你需要查看多个客户的状态、做客户组合概览时触发；前提是存在可访问且有权限的记录。若由 @fde 调用，则复用其当前的净化数据包和范围。

say.text: 汇总一下现有客户组合的当前状态
say.note: 只依据已有接触记录给概览

say.text: 哪些客户缺少接触记录或我没有权限？
say.note: 缺失记录和权限会作为限制列出

say.text: 按 @fde 的净化数据包和范围看客户状态
say.note: 复用其范围，不重新走设置流程

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude reviews and reports the status of the portfolio based on existing engagement records, distinguishing implementation, verification, deployment and acceptance. Missing records or access are reported as limitations; it does not invent client histories.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for status across multiple customers or a portfolio overview, and accessible permitted records exist. If called by @fde, it reuses that sanitized packet and scope.

say_en.text: Summarize the current status of our customer portfolio.
say_en.note: Overview from existing engagement records only.

say_en.text: Which customers lack engagement records or my access?
say_en.note: Missing records and access are listed as limitations.

say_en.text: Show customer status using @fde's sanitized packet and scope.
say_en.note: Reuses its scope, no restart of setup.
